name: @feldspar/bash
title: Bash scripts
description: Run a bash script on the server from a trigger, or let an agent run bash commands here or over SSH. Unsafe: a script can do anything the server's user can, so this server installs it only when started with FELDSPAR_ALLOW_UNSAFE_MODULES=1.
supplies: An action, "run_bash_script": runs the script typed into the trigger or held in a field of the row, with the row's fields as ROW_* variables, and answers its exit code, stdout and stderr, optionally writing them back to fields of the row.

An agent trait, "run_bash" (v1's "Run Bash command" skill): the agent's run_bash tool runs a command the model writes, on the server or on another machine over SSH (ssh -o BatchMode=yes, so only hosts reached without a password). Offered only to an administrator's chat at the admin console.
unsafe: its action and its agent trait run any bash command on the server, as the server's own user
